workItems.title: [Report Designer] Configure template time-series orientation
workItems.description:
As a Report Author
I want to set whether periodic data flows horizontally (across columns) or vertically (down rows) when I create a template
So that the template's layout matches the report structure I need, before I begin linking variables

Size estimate: TBD � shell created for estimation
Sequencing note: Logically precedes variable linking (1869322) � orientation should be set before an Author starts linking variables, since changing it later clears existing links.

Requirements

Set orientation
Author sets time-series orientation (horizontal/vertical) as a one-time setup decision, early in template creation.

Destructive change warning
Changing orientation after variables are already linked clears all existing links in the template. Author must be warned with a confirmation dialog and must confirm before this destructive action proceeds.

Orientation applies template-wide
Once set, all periodic variable links in the template follow the chosen orientation � this is a template-level structural setting, not a per-link property.
